origin: V3-unseen: blind-cases.json byte-identical to RC2-V3-set (same 160 CORE + 122 reserve, no case content changes)

encryption.answer_key_aad: UTF-8 bytes of the blind-cases.json SHA-256 hex string; envelope associated_data field is urlsafe-b64 of those same hex-string bytes
encryption.construction_audit_aad: exact ASCII bytes construction-audit:v1, fresh nonce, separate envelope; envelope associated_data field is urlsafe-b64 of that ASCII string
encryption.decrypt_reverification: 2026-09-04 in-memory: answer key decrypts with AAD blind-cases-hex; 160 cases; final/criticality/flags/rationale/annotation_status complete; 62/62 compound with complete atoms; construction audit decrypts with AAD construction-audit:v1

subgroup_note: 12 preregistered subgroups map to 11 case flags (safety, legal, numeric, temporal, locality, modality, actor, cond_exc, compound, multi_span, age_legal) plus the label-derived insufficiency class (final semantic_truth INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE); membership computable from sealed+public metadata without manual case selection

criticality.rule: critical iff final_flags intersect {safety, age_legal}; documented deterministic rule, 40 critical / 120 standard

annotation_agreement.method: claim-text matched atom pairs across independent pass1/pass2
annotation_agreement.structural_divergence: 9 cases with different atom counts (split/merge artifacts), adjudicated to canonical atom sets

top_level_consistency.method: deterministic aggregation of adjudicated atoms per contract v3 slot mapping, compared with V3 top-level
top_level_consistency.relabel_details: sealed in construction-audit bundle (spec 26: expected verdict not in public metadata)
